items.title: NYC Council Candidate Videos
items.body:
To qualify for our ballot candidates must either be previously endorsed incumbents seeking reelection or have submitted SDNYC’s questionnaire. To view questionnaire responses, Click Here.

In addition, SDNYC has invited Council candidates seeking our endorsement to submit optional videos for our membership to review in advance of voting at our meeting on 4/21. See below for the videos that have been submitted thus far. This page will be updated as additional candidates submit videos.

items.title: UPCOMING EVENTS!
items.body:
On April 21st, SDNYC will be joined by LGDCQ to hear from candidates running for NYC Mayor, Public Advocate, and Comptroller. Eligible SDNYC Members will also receive ballots to vote endorse in these Citywide races as well as NYC Council races.

CANDIDATES - to be eligible for SDNYC's endorsement you MUST submit our questionnaire by 4/12 details on our website: http://sdnyc.org/2021-primary-endorsements


On April 28th, SDNYC will hear from candidates running for Borough President and District Attorney. Eligible SDNYC Members will also receive ballots to vote endorse in these races.

CANDIDATES - to be eligible for SDNYC's endorsement you MUST submit our questionnaire by 4/12 details on our website: http://sdnyc.org/2021-primary-endorsements

items.title: SDNYC Calls on Andrew Cuomo to Resign
SDNYC 2021 Special Election Endorsements
items.body:
On Wednesday evening we held a virtual meeting where we heard from candidates requesting the club endorsement in the Special Elections to fill vacancies in City Council Districts 11, 15, 24, and 31. Below are our endorsement results:


CD 11 - Eric Dinowitz

CD 15 - Elisa Crespo

CD 24 - Jim Gennaro

CD 31 - No Endorsement

The election for District 24 (Queens) is on February 2, the election for District 31 (Queens) is on February 23, and the election for Districts 11 (Bronx) and 15 (Bronx) will be held March 23. Thank you to everyone who participated in the endorsement process and meeting.
